meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages. Use when the target is a syntax pattern (every call/class/import shaped like X, a codemod, a YAML rule) rather than literal text; for plain strings, comments, or filenames, use rg.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码的语法结构搜索并批量重写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在大量文件里按语法结构统一改代码
copy.tagline_en: Search and rewrite code by its syntax structure, at scale
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to edit code by syntax pattern across many files

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按代码的语法结构（而非文本）在 25 种语言里搜索和改写代码：找出某个形状的调用、类、导入，执行 codemod，或跑 YAML 规则。它默认走自带的 helper 脚本，改写前先做预演、不直接落盘。
howto.when: 当需求取决于代码结构而不是文本字节时触发，例如按形状查找或改写代码、跑 YAML 规则；若目标只是字符串内容、注释或文件名，它会改用 rg。

say.text: 找出所有接收 Request 参数的函数
say.note: 按 AST 形状搜索，返回匹配位置

say.text: 跑一遍项目里的 YAML 规则，报告违例
say.note: 从当前目录发现 sgconfig.yml 后扫描

howto.what_en: It searches and rewrites code by AST shape across 25 languages: find calls, classes or imports of a given shape, run codemods, or apply YAML rules. It defaults to a bundled helper script, and rewrites preview matches before applying.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the goal depends on code structure, not text bytes, such as finding or rewriting code by shape, or running YAML rules. For plain strings, comments or filenames it switches to rg.

say_en.text: Find every function that takes a Request parameter.
Rewrite every console.log(x) to logger.info(x); show the dry run first.
say_en.note: Dry-run by default; nothing is written until you apply.

say_en.text: Run the project's YAML rules and report violations.
